lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Colin Bauer is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Colin is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d40: 🕯️ Colin Bauer is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Colin kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Colin's gone." Booker looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Colin." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Paolo blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.

d40: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Colin's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Colin Bauer, 40 days. The mantle passes to Paolo Navarro.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Paolo Navarro, 22 — a Pharmacist. Their hands know different work now: The Touch, Purify, Dowsing.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Colin — and Colin is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Booker, Bekzat, Ekaterina and 5 more speak for Paolo — "Colin trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Paolo before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
